notes.title: 1.0 Update
notes.content: Hello everyone! First off, thank you so much to everyone that's bought and played Permanence Break. We apologize for the delay in updates and communication. We will not be able to deliver on all the roadmap plans, but we are excited to announce our 1.0 update coming this Sunday! On October 13th, we will be adding new levels and features, some coming with a few new mechanics to play with, and some graphical changes. Beyond that we will be wrapping up active development as our small team moves on to other projects. We truly appreciate everyone who has played Permanence Break, your support means a lot! Thank you and we hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020980/2f81715169b1e1d8b87cf123a99a8eb69b09c8c2.png[/img]

Hello everyone! First off we would like to thank everyone who has wishlisted or bought Permanence Break. We truly appreciate your support.

As you all know, we still have many new features and improvements to add before we make our full release, planned for mid September. To make sure we keep all of you in the loop we would like to share our plan moving forward. Above you will see our schedule from now until early September. You can expect updates to be release on each of the dates shown, bringing you more content and mechanics and some graphical, performance and control improvements.

As always we welcome community feedback and suggestions, so please feel free to contact us on our Discord server or leave a comment on this post!

Thank you again for all your support. We are so excited to keep sharing this project with everyone!
-The Permanence Break Team

notes.title: Releasing as Early Access Soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First off we would like to apologize for the last minute announcement. Permanence Break will not be releasing today. In addition we will be switching from free to play to a $2 game. These changes will not be reflected on our store page right away, but we are in the process of correcting that. We thank you for your understanding as we work to make our first published game the best it can be.

Permanence Break started as our senior capstone project at UCSC, but it wont end there. We have more ideas and mechanics we will add to the game over the summer, with a full release planned for September 1st. Thank you to everyone that has wishlisted our game and we look forward to sharing these additions with you!

Apologies and Thank you,
The Permanence Break Devs
